links.comparator_used: Same ViT-B/16 fine-tuning without differential privacy (non-private baseline)
links.outcome: Breast ultrasound classification accuracy, F1 and AUC-ROC
links.effect: Non-DP: 94.9% accuracy, 93.4% F1, 99.2% AUC-ROC. DP at ε=10, δ=1e-5: 89.5% accuracy, 86.0% F1, 96.1% AUC-ROC. DP at ε=1, δ=0.1: 87.4% accuracy, 82.8% F1, 94.1% AUC-ROC. DP at ε=0.01, δ=1e-5: 48.3% accuracy, 43.5% F1, 48.6% AUC-ROC. ANOVA showed ε as the dominant factor (P<0.001).
links.tradeoff: Monotonic privacy-utility trade-off: performance declined as ε decreased, with collapse to near-chance at ε=0.01.
links.quote: Introducing DP produced a clear monotonic privacy-utility trade-off: performance declined as ε decreased.

design_hint: differential privacy parameter selection (epsilon/delta) for training
